subject: PE
title: PE 10 (Course 2)
description: High School Physical Education Course 2, following the CA model content standards for adventure/outdoor activities, combatives (self-defense), individual and dual activities, dance, aquatics/gymnastics, and team activities. Students take the Physical Fitness Test (FITNESSGRAM) items, design and monitor personal fitness plans using FITT principles, and study the psychological and social aspects of activity such as leadership, group dynamics, and risk management. Activities are adapted for home, parks, and community facilities.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards (High School Course 2); 2009 CA Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-HS2-1.1: Demonstrate proficient movement skills in outdoor/adventure activities (e.g., hiking, orienteering, climbing).
standards.PE-HS2-1.2: Explain and apply safety practices and risk management in adventure and outdoor activities.
standards.PE-HS2-1.3: Demonstrate basic self-defense and combative skills, including escapes, falls and blocks.
standards.PE-HS2-1.4: Explain and demonstrate strategies for avoiding dangerous situations and self-protection.
standards.PE-HS2-1.5: Demonstrate proficient skills and strategies in individual and dual activities (e.g., tennis, badminton, pickleball).
standards.PE-HS2-1.6: Demonstrate proficient skills in dance and rhythmic activities, including creating a movement sequence.
standards.PE-HS2-1.7: Demonstrate proficient skills in gymnastics/tumbling or aquatics activities with correct technique and safety.
standards.PE-HS2-1.8: Demonstrate advanced offensive, defensive, and transition strategies in team activities.
standards.PE-HS2-1.9: Apply biomechanical principles (force, leverage, levers, center of gravity) to analyze and improve performance.
standards.PE-HS2-2.1: Participate in moderate to vigorous physical activity at least four days each week.
standards.PE-HS2-2.2: Meet health-fitness standards for aerobic capacity, body composition, muscular strength, endurance, and flexibility (FITNESSGRAM).
standards.PE-HS2-2.3: Develop and implement a personal fitness plan using the FITT principles and monitor progress.
standards.PE-HS2-2.4: Explain the relationship between nutrition, hydration, rest, and performance.
standards.PE-HS2-2.5: Use heart-rate monitoring and perceived exertion to regulate training intensity.
standards.PE-HS2-3.1: Explain and demonstrate leadership, cooperation and group dynamics in physical activity settings.
standards.PE-HS2-3.2: Accept responsibility for personal safety and the safety of others; demonstrate ethical behavior and sportsmanship.
standards.PE-HS2-3.3: Identify and evaluate the benefits of lifelong participation in physical activity, including community resources.
